description: This file defines functions and data structures for reading and parsing IPVS (IP Virtual Server) statistics and backend status from the Linux /proc filesystem, specifically from files like /proc/net/ip_vs_stats and /proc/net/ip_vs. It includes parsing logic for extracting connection counts, traffic data, and backend server details, supporting monitoring of IPVS state.

methods.name: parseIPVSStats
methods.description: Parses the IPVS statistics from an io.Reader, extracting connection counts and traffic data from the /proc/net/ip_vs_stats file.

methods.name: parseIPVSBackendStatus
methods.description: Parses the backend server status information from an io.Reader, extracting details about virtual and real IP addresses, ports, and connection metrics.

methods.name: parseIPPort
methods.description: Converts a string representation of an IP address and port in hex format into net.IP and uint16 port.
